name: A Special Kind of Help
jem_summary: Receive one companion capability: Flutter pollen, Mudskipper mud, a trained octopus form or a potion-coated rhino strike. Native radiation removal by a tamed Raycat also qualifies.

pages.title: A Special Kind of Help
pages.text: An unusual companion helps through its species-specific ability.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Flutter tames with different flowers and gains pot armor. Mudskipper takes lobster tails. Tame an uncamouflaged octopus with tails and train with Mimicream. Pacify rhino with wheat; potion coating supports a limited number of horn attacks. Tame Raycat with Radgill; it absorbs owner Irradiated and

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: deters Nucleepers rather than acting as a combat defender.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Capture Radgill using an Acid Bucket; it can grow in ordinary water. The fish tames Raycats and can also be cooked.
